title: Mechanistic Insights into Loop Dynamics in Reshaping the Conformation of YB-1 Cold Shock Domain.
authors: Sun, Min; Zhang, Beirong; He, Xiaofang; Zhang, Jingfeng; Zhao, Qun; Zhang, Xu; Liu, Maili; Gong, Zhou
journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子MD模拟结合NMR和交联实验，揭示YB-1冷休克结构域C端延伸环的动态网络如何稳定结构并调控其与DNA的结合亲和力，聚焦蛋白-DNA互作机制，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配课题。
abstract: The human Y-box binding protein 1 (YB-1) plays a crucial role in various cellular processes. The cold shock domain (CSD) of YB-1 is responsible for specific nucleic acid recognition and exhibits a unique beta-barrel structure. While the CSD alone is unstable, the addition of 11 residues at the C-terminus significantly stabilizes the structure. This study investigates the molecular mechanisms by which this extended loop region influences the structure and dynamics of the CSD using all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, complemented by NMR and crosslinking experiments. Our simulations reveal that the extended loop forms a sandwich-like interaction network with the CSD, stabilizing the overall structure. This network involves hydrogen bonds and non-covalent interactions, preventing the loop from collapsing due to electrostatic attractions. Furthermore, we show that phosphorylation of S102 within the loop region disrupts this network, leading to increased structural flexibility and conformational changes. This disruption weakens the interaction between CSD and DNA, explaining the experimentally observed decrease in binding affinity upon phosphorylation. Our results provide mechanistic insights into the role of loop dynamics in reshaping the conformation of the YB-1 CSD.
abstract_zh: 人Y-box结合蛋白1（YB-1）在多种细胞过程中发挥关键作用。YB-1的冷休克结构域（CSD）负责特异性核酸识别，并展现出独特的β-桶状结构。尽管单独的CSD不稳定，但在C端添加11个残基可显著稳定该结构。本研究利用全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟，辅以核磁共振（NMR）和交联实验，探讨了这一延伸环区域影响CSD结构和动力学的分子机制。我们的模拟揭示，延伸环与CSD形成三明治样相互作用网络，从而稳定整体结构。该网络涉及氢键和非共价相互作用，防止环因静电吸引而塌缩。此外，我们证明环区域内S102的磷酸化会破坏此网络，导致结构灵活性和构象变化增加。这种破坏削弱了CSD与DNA之间的相互作用，解释了实验观察到的磷酸化后结合亲和力下降现象。我们的结果为环动力学在重塑YB-1 CSD构象中的作用提供了机制性见解。
